_comment: Fleet used for the ISA experiment. REQreate instances carry no fleet, so
request_vehicle_ratio) are computed from this file.
The default below is fleet FF from Melis & Queiroz, 'Heterogeneous ODBRP'
40% capacity-8 (T2). The parallel-algorithm paper reuses the same fleet
('the total fleet size remains constant in all experiments', Section 7.2).
Vehicle types in that paper: T1 = 4 seats, T2 = 8 seats, T3 = 12 seats.
